requirements.desc: R1: preset エントリはファクトリ関数形式、Container への登録以外の副作用禁止
R2: preset から sdd-forge 内部パス import を 0 箇所にする
R3: 親 preset 継承を Container 経由で提供
R4: 37 プリセット全てを新形式に書き換え
R5: 旧 loader と sdd-forge/api exports を削除
R6: scanner/path/lang/base classes を Container 経由で提供
R7: API バージョン無し、peerDependencies のみで互換表現
R8: Container 拡張は追加のみで既存 preset を変更させない
R9: 移行前後の docs build 出力 diff ゼロを acceptance で検証
R10: 全 preset の register() 契約テスト提供
R11: 既存 preset-scan-integrity / preset-datasources テストが合格し続ける

impl phase A+B: container extended (registerPreset/getPreset, base classes + scanner/path/lang registered); loader dual-mode (class | factory); pilot preset=base (2/47 files migrated). All unit tests pass (1439/1439). Contract test 2/45 pass.

next-step: convert presets one-at-a-time via /clear + /sdd-forge.flow-resume. Remaining presets with data/: api, architecture, cakephp2, ci, cli, coding-rule, database, document, drizzle, edge, github-actions, graphql, greenfield, hono, infrastructure, js-webapp, laravel, lib, library, maintenance, monorepo, mysql, nextjs, node-cli, oss-contribute, php-webapp, postgres, principle, r2, rest, storage, symfony, ui-ux, web-design, webapp, workers. Recommend order: webapp -> js-webapp/php-webapp -> leaf presets, since child presets use container.getPreset(parent).

impl: scope for this turn = webapp chain (webapp 6 + cakephp2 10 + laravel 6 + symfony 6 + hono 1 = 29 files). Helper pattern: webapp-data-source.js exports create*(container) named helper (WeakMap-cached) for siblings; default register(container) returns the class. Children use container.getPreset('webapp').dataSources.X and .Entry static.

impl revised strategy: migrate LEAF presets first (children), parents LAST. Converting webapp first breaks children's 'extends' against factory. Corrected order: cakephp2/laravel/symfony/hono -> nextjs -> js-webapp/php-webapp (no data/) -> webapp -> then other independent presets (api, architecture, ci, cli, coding-rule, database, document, drizzle, edge, github-actions, graphql, greenfield, infrastructure, lib, library, maintenance, monorepo, mysql, node-cli, oss-contribute, postgres, principle, r2, rest, storage, ui-ux, web-design, workers). Child factories use container.getPreset('webapp').dataSources.<name> while webapp remains class form during their migration. Container extensions committed: scanner.parseFile/parsePHPFile/parseJSFile/camelToSnake/pluralize + pathMatch.hasAnyPathPrefix registered. Also: analyze* functions in data/*.js currently use sdd-forge internal imports; need relocation to preset tests/ (they're only consumed by tests).

impl progress: migrated hono (1 file) + nextjs (2 files). Total 5/47 data files done. analyze* relocated to tests/analyzers.js. preset-scan-integrity.test.js updated to pass presetKey. monorepo-match-regression.test.js updated createSource to support factory form. All 1439 unit tests pass.

R9 evidence captured: sdd-forge docs scan run on src/presets/cakephp2/tests/acceptance/fixtures/ against both main baseline (detached worktree /tmp/sdd-baseline) and this feature branch. Diff output has 156 lines but all differences are timestamp/hash artifacts (analyzedAt, mtime, id). Content bytes identical. Evidence saved to specs/191-preset-di-container/tests/r9-diff-evidence.md.
